propositions: Documentation-only patchsets must select a reduced docs-only Verify lane that skips OS/Python matrix and mutation jobs while retaining all documentation-related gates (ADR validation, index, cross-reference, quickstart, drift checks).

The trusted classifier job must execute only from origin/main with the exact patchset diff as name-only untrusted data; it fails closed to full Verify on any non-allowlisted path, malformed diff, parent-resolution failure, or classifier error.
Extracted documentation gates must have one shared definition in a composite action that both routes invoke post-checkout without increasing full-lane runner usage.

Every structural consumer of _build-and-test.yml must follow extracted gates; classifier failure must block Verified even when full fallback jobs pass; classifier success plus route=docs-only is required for docs-only execution.
Python, shell, executable, workflow, action, dependency, lockfile, test, fixture, and configuration paths must route to full Verify; unrecognized or empty diffs must also route full.

Production evidence must demonstrate genuine docs-only changes (CHANGELOG.md) select docs-only route with 82.4% wall-clock and 93.9% runner-minute savings, and genuine non-doc changes select and complete the full test suite without regression.
